name: CHARLES STEPHENS
message:
TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN:

I RECENTLY PURCHASED A PACK OF YOUR KAMEL RED LIGHTS. TO MY DISMAY, WHEN I OPENED THE PACK, I FOUND ONLY 19 CIGARETTES AT $2.37 A PACK. WHEN I BUY CIGARETTES, I WOULD LIKE TO PAY FOR WHAT I'M EXPECTING TO GET.

SINCERELY, (PISSED OFF)
Charles Stephens
